exports.description: List of NFS export entries to configure. Each entry defines a directory to export, which clients may access, and under what permissions and options.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory to export (e.g., /srv/nfs/shared)

client.description: Client specification: hostname, IP address, network in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24), or wildcard (*). Supports wildcards like *.example.com for domain-wide access.

options.description: List of NFS export options (see `man 5 exports`). Common options include ro (read-only), rw (read-write), no_root_squash, sync, async, secure, no_subtree_check, nohide, crossmnt, etc.
